articles.title: Four Wynn Restaurants Recognized in the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Awards
articles.summary: Macao, September 9, 2026 – Four of Wynn's signature restaurants have been honored at Trip.Gourmet's 10th Anniversary Edition: Global Restaurant Rankings and Fine Dining Awards Ceremony held in Singapore on September 8. Chef Tam's Seasons received the highest honor of "Black Diamond" award, while Mizumi, Wing Lei and Drunken Fish were each honored with the prestigious "Platinum" award.

articles.title: Wynn Launches 20th Anniversary Share Award for Team Members

articles.title: Wynn Palace Becomes the First in Macao to Debut on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 Extended 51-100 List
articles.summary: Macao, September 2, 2026 – Wynn Palace has been named No.96 on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 extended 51–100 list, becoming the first hotel in Macao to be recognized in the prestigious global award. The accolade recognizes Wynn Palace's commitment to bespoke hospitality, world-class gastronomy and resort experiences.
